measurement.title: When the Party Gets Louder Than the Conversation

notes:
An evening party in a pub near Bank, in the heart of London. A lively atmosphere, people enjoying themselves, conversations overlapping — and a surprisingly overwhelming level of noise.

This SPL Reference measurement captures the acoustic reality of a social evening where simply having a conversation becomes a challenge.

How much noise are we exposed to during an ordinary night out, without even realising it? We often associate hearing risks with concerts and nightclubs, yet a few hours in a crowded pub can also contribute significantly to our cumulative sound exposure.

An interesting comparison with restaurants, live music events and other social environments — and a reminder that having a good time doesn’t necessarily mean our ears are having one too.
